summary: win_splitdrive splits a Windows path into drive (up to the colon, or UNC host and share) and the rest of the path.
questions: How do I get the drive letter from a Windows path?
How do I split a UNC path into share and path?

answer_card.title: win_splitdrive filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ path | win_splitdrive }}` returns `[drive, rest]`. With a drive letter, drive includes everything up to and including the colon. With a UNC path, drive is the host and share, up to but not including the fourth separator.
